critical_code_review_comments: Activate.jsx: handles no-token well but on POST /auth/activate failure (e.g. expired token) the toast surfaces formatApiError(detail) — OK, but there is no explicit 'link expired' hint; consider mapping 410/expired to a clearer CTA 'Ask your advisor to resend'.

AdvisorClients InviteModal: invite-activation-link text container includes the copy button inside its text node, so programmatic text_content() yields link+button glyph concatenated; not a bug but makes selector extraction mildly awkward — consider wrapping the URL in a separate inner span with its own data-testid.
resendInvite path: if backend returned emailed=false and clipboard write fails (navigator.clipboard undefined on insecure contexts), silently proceeds — add a fallback toast with the link visible.
server.py keeps growing (now adds /auth/activate + /advisor/clients/invite/resend + /advisor/tasks CRUD on top of iter15); file-split into routers is still overdue (noted since iter14).

Shell.getNav uses user.is_client ONLY in the tier==='solo' branch — correct today since invited clients are always solo, but worth a comment or an explicit guard so future tier changes don't accidentally give invited enterprise/advisor-side clients the full suite.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter16 all green. Key patterns: (a) advisor MFA must be reset before testing — use repo.update_user with mfa_enabled=False, mfa_secret=None; then login via REST+pyotp (reads 'secret' from mfa_setup response) and inject token into localStorage.compass_token to skip the UI MFA ceremony. (b) /activate expects ?token=<jwt type:activate> from invite response; POST /auth/activate {token,new_password} sets password and clears must_change. (c) Invited clients get is_client=true, tier=solo and their Shell nav is trimmed to dashboard/insights/goals/profile only. (d) OpportunitiesList: window.prompt is still used for log-task — Playwright dialog handler required (page.once('dialog', lambda d: d.accept(title))). (e) task-count-<client_id> appears on BOTH queue card (iter16 added `1 task` line on queue row) and opps row; it reflects open tasks only (done=false). (f) Resend returns the new activation_link + emailed boolean; toast message differs on emailed vs copy-fallback path.
